'''Expanded Crucible''' is an [[AIC]] [[Facilities|facility]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Item description|A facility for running solid or liquid-state chemical reactions. It also comes with additional input and output ports and the ability to run multiple reactions simultaneously.|Higher capacity. Better safety.}}
